title: Project Templates
concept: Project templates scaffold new projects with best practices built in — `xiom init` creates a complete project structure in seconds.
why: Setting up a new project from scratch takes time and leads to inconsistency. Templates ensure every project starts with the right structure and tooling.
theory:
## Scaffolding New Projects

### Basic Initialization

```sh
# Create a new project
xiom init myapp

# Creates:
myapp/
├── package.xi          # Package manifest
├── src/
│   └── main.xi         # Entry point
├── .gitignore
├── xiom-toolchain.toml  # Pinned compiler version
├── xiomfmt.toml         # Formatter config
├── xiomlint.toml        # Linter config
└── .github/
    └── workflows/
        └── ci.yml       # CI workflow
```

### Template Types

```sh
# Library template
xiom init --lib mylibrary
# Creates: src/lib.xi (not main.xi)

# Workspace template
xiom init --workspace myproject
# Creates: multi-package workspace structure

# WebAssembly template
xiom init --wasm mywebapp
# Creates: WASM project with JS bindings

# Embedded template
xiom init --embedded myfirmware
# Creates: no_std project for bare metal

# Custom template
xiom init --template https://github.com/user/template myapp
```

### Template Structure

```xiom
// Generated src/main.xi
//! ${project_name}
//!
//! ${project_description}

module ${project_name}.main;

fn main() -> Int {
  io.println("Hello from ${project_name}!");
  return 0;
}
```

### Creating Custom Templates

```sh
# Create from existing project
xiom template create mytemplate --from ./myproject

# Publish template
xiom template publish mytemplate

# List available templates
xiom template list
```

### Template Variables

| Variable | Value |
|----------|-------|
| `${project_name}` | Project name |
| `${author}` | Git user name |
| `${year}` | Current year |
| `${xiom_version}` | Current XIOM version |
syntax_ref:
xiom init <name>                  # New project
xiom init --lib <name>            # New library
xiom init --wasm <name>           # New WASM project
xiom init --template <url> <name> # From template
tips: Always use `xiom init` instead of creating projects manually — templates include best practices
Library template (--lib) creates the right structure for reusable packages
Templates include CI configuration — your project is CI-ready from the first commit
Create custom templates for your team/project patterns — consistency at scale
common_mistakes: Creating projects manually and forgetting CI, formatter, or linter configuration
Using the wrong template type — lib template for a binary, or vice versa
Not updating the generated README and package.xi with real content
